meta.title: Boligboost – AI-enhanced property photos, virtual staging and sale boost
meta.description: We enhance your photos with AI, furnish empty rooms digitally and show how simple upgrades can lift your property – delivered in 24–48 hours.

hero.h1: Your first photo decides whether they click.
hero.subtitle: We get your photos ready for FINN and Airbnb – brighter, sharper and more inviting. No photographer needed, delivered in 24 hours.

stue.caption: A brighter, sharper living room, straightened horizon, loose clutter removed.

kjokken.caption: Warmer light and cleaner colours in the kitchen.

soverom.caption: A more inviting bedroom with better light and sharpness.

problem.heading: You only have a few seconds.
points: People scroll past listings with dark or messy photos – no matter how good the home is.
The first photo and the title decide whether anyone clicks.
Every month your property sits empty costs you a full month's rent. If a 15,000 NOK/month rental stays empty one extra month, you've lost 15,000 NOK.

howItWorks.heading: Three simple steps.
steps: Send us your photos or a link to your listing.
We enhance them and deliver within 24–48 hours.
You upload the new photos and get more clicks.

servicesOverview.heading: Find the right boost for your property.

honesty.heading: We enhance – we don't mislead.
points: We adjust light, colour, sharpness and straight lines, and remove loose clutter.
We never change walls, floors, windows, views or damage.
Digitally furnished photos are always labelled, with the original shown alongside.
For Airbnb we only do natural enhancement: no furniture that isn't there, and no text in the photos.

about.name: Melanie Solberg
about.bio: I'm Melanie Solberg, and I started Boligboost because too many great homes get scrolled past because of dark, cluttered photos. I have a background in sales, management and digital marketing, and I also run SynligAI, which helps businesses become visible in AI search. At Boligboost I use AI to get your property ready for clicks – and I check every single photo myself, so the result is honest and looks natural.
about.replyNote: I reply to emails within 24 hours on weekdays.

items.a: Yes, as long as the photos don't mislead. We improve light and quality, label virtual staging and never change fixed features or damage.

items.q: Can I use the photos on Airbnb?
items.a: Yes, Photo Boost is made for that. We keep it natural and never add text to the photos.
You confirm you have the rights to the photos you send. You get full rights to use the result.

items.q: How fast do I get them?
items.a: Photo Boost within 24 hours, staging and Sale Boost within 48 hours.
You get one free revision, or your money back.
No. We use the photos you have, including phone photos.

items.q: Does Sale Boost increase the value?
items.a: Many simple upgrades make a home more attractive. How much the value may increase should be assessed by an agent or valuer. We don't promise a specific amount.
You receive an invoice by email after delivery.

finalCta.heading: Ready for more clicks? Send us your photos today.

pricingNote: All prices include VAT. Estate agents are invoiced excl. VAT.

photoBoost.heading: Make your own photos ready for FINN and Airbnb
photoBoost.forWho: Suitable for: private landlords, Airbnb hosts and people selling privately, who have taken the photos themselves.
photoBoost.whatItIs: Send us the photos you have. We enhance them with AI: light, colour, sharpness, straight lines and removal of loose clutter. You also get a stronger cover photo and title suggestions.
includes: A selected and optimised cover photo
photoBoost.note: For Airbnb we only do natural enhancement, as Airbnb's rules require.

virtualStaging.heading: Furnish empty rooms – or replace what holds them back
virtualStaging.forWho: Suitable for: empty properties for sale or long-term rental, and properties with furniture that isn't included in the sale, like a worn sofa.
virtualStaging.whatItIs: We furnish empty rooms digitally, or replace loose furniture that isn't included in the sale, like a worn sofa. Fixed features such as walls, floors, kitchens and windows are never changed.
includes: Labelled "Virtual staging – illustration. Furniture not included."
virtualStaging.note: Not for Airbnb, where guests must see the furniture they actually get.

saleBoostLarge.heading: Large
saleBoostLarge.priceNote: upgrades NOK 20,000–100,000, 10 before/after and a prioritised list

services.saleBoostValueNote: How much the value may increase is assessed by your estate agent or valuer. We show what it costs and how it could look.
services.saleBoostHeading: Show buyers what the home could become – and what it costs
services.saleBoostForWho: Suitable for: properties needing renovation that are being sold, or that have been on the market a long time. For sellers and estate agents.
services.saleBoostWhatItIs: We create before/after images of simple upgrades, like painting cabinets and walls, refreshing the worktop with film or oiling the floor. You get a report with the work, costs and the order to do it in. Do the work and your listing gets real new photos. Don't, and buyers still see the potential.
saleBoostIncludes: Sale Boost report (PDF) with the work, costs and what requires a professional

thanks.heading: Thank you!
thanks.body: You'll get a reply by email within 24 hours.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains what Boligboost collects when you use the order form, why, and what rights you have.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you fill in the order form, we store your name, email, customer type, requested service, a link to your photos, any comment, and whether you consent to marketing use of the before/after photos.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
sections.body: The information is used to deliver the service you order, respond to your enquiry and send an invoice. Marketing consent is only used if you've ticked that box.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep order information for as long as necessary for delivery and bookkeeping, normally up to 5 years in line with Norwegian accounting law.

sections.heading: Sub-processors
sections.body: The form is run on Netlify (Netlify Forms), which receives and stores submissions. We also use email and may use analytics tools to understand how the site is used.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data by contacting us by email.

terms.heading: Terms
terms.intro: These terms apply when you order a service from Boligboost.

sections.heading: Photo rights
sections.body: By ordering, you confirm you have the right to use the photos you submit, and that we may edit them for you.

sections.heading: Right to use the result
sections.body: You get full rights to use the enhanced photos and any reports we deliver.

sections.heading: Labelling
sections.body: Digitally furnished photos and Sale Boost illustrations are always clearly labelled, so there's no doubt about what's real and what's an illustration.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
sections.body: You are responsible for how and where the photos are published, and for ensuring publication follows applicable rules, such as Airbnb's guidelines.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: You receive an invoice by email after delivery, due within 14 days.

sections.heading: If you're not happy
sections.body: You get one free revision, or your money back.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: Norwegian law applies to these terms.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.intro: We only use cookies after consent, and you can change your choice at any time.

sections.heading: Necessary
sections.body: A few technical cookies are necessary for the site to function, and don't require consent.

sections.heading: Analytics and marketing
sections.body: Analytics and marketing tools (such as GA4 and Meta Pixel) are only loaded if you've accepted this in the consent banner.

sections.heading: Change consent
sections.body: You can change your consent at any time via the "Change consent" link in the footer.

consent.message: We use cookies for analytics and marketing. You choose what you accept.
